narrative: Material PL1__M78165D5 shows lumpy demand (CV=0.59) with moderate lead time variability (CV=0.43, mean ~2.96 days). The current SAP policy holds zero safety stock, creating significant stockout risk at the 95% service level target. An (r,Q) continuous-review policy with a 584-unit safety stock and 1,629-unit order quantity is recommended, satisfying the capacity constraint (max inventory 2,213 vs limit 4,307) and aligning ordering/holding costs via EOQ.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Lumpy demand with CV>0.5 and moderate lead time variability favours continuous-review over periodic review; EOQ balances ordering and holding costs efficiently; MOQ (35) is non-binding relative to EOQ (1,629).
research_insights.boundary_risk: Capacity does not bind. Post-replenishment max inventory (584+1629=2213) is well within the 4,307-unit storage limit, leaving 2,094 units headroom.
